summary.text: Taylor Crouse is the Republican candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Luke Rae.
Crouse is a real estate agent and small business owner who, in a Ballotpedia survey, describes his platform as fiscal responsibility, school choice and keeping taxes low.

paragraphs.text: Taylor Crouse graduated from Savannah R-3 High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Missouri Western State College in 2001.
His career experience includes working as a real estate agent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Crouse described himself as the father of three boys and two stepdaughters, a lifelong Missourian and a small business owner.
Crouse listed opposing government overreach, applying business principles to state government efficiency, and fixing roads and bridges as his key campaign messages in the survey.
He said he is running on fiscal responsibility, broader school choice options, support for small businesses and economic development, and keeping taxes low.
